name: turn_id
description: Unique conversational turn telemetry identifier (insertId deduplication key)

name: recorded_at
description: UTC timestamp when the conversational turn completed

name: session_id
description: Conversational session identifier

name: turn_index
description: 1-based turn index within the conversational session

name: user_id
description: Authenticated analyst or service principal executing the turn

name: intent
description: RootOrchestrator classified query intent

name: execution_mode
description: ADK execution mode (live_adk, deterministic_react, guardrail_blocked)

name: status
description: Turn completion outcome (success or blocked)

name: tickers_analyzed
description: Canonical SEC ticker symbols analyzed during the turn

name: companies_analyzed_count
description: Count of distinct companies analyzed in this turn

name: gics_sector
description: Active GICS sector scope filter

name: start_year
description: Start fiscal year of the analytical scope

name: end_year
description: End fiscal year of the analytical scope

name: report_generated
description: Whether a grounded financial report was synthesized and returned

name: variance_reports_count
description: Number of deterministic CompanyVarianceReport records computed

name: citations_count
description: Number of grounded 10-K passage citations attached to the report

name: tool_invocations
description: Ordered list of ADK tools invoked during the turn

name: tool_invocation_count
description: Total number of ADK tool invocations in this turn

name: llm_call_count
description: Number of Gemini Pro/Flash calls attributed to this turn

name: total_context_tokens
description: Total input context tokens across all turn LLM calls

name: cached_context_tokens
description: Cached input tokens across all turn LLM calls

name: output_tokens
description: Generated output + reasoning tokens across all turn LLM calls

name: total_cost_usd
description: Total LLM token cost in USD for the turn

name: cached_token_savings_usd
description: USD saved via context-cached 10-K tokens on the turn

name: ttft_ms
description: Observed or attributed Time to First Thought / Token (ms)

name: total_latency_ms
description: End-to-end turn wall-clock latency (ms)

name: session_cumulative_turns
description: Cumulative turns executed in this session (session length)

name: session_cumulative_companies_count
description: Cumulative distinct companies analyzed in this session

name: session_cumulative_reports_count
description: Cumulative grounded reports generated in this session

name: session_elapsed_seconds
description: Elapsed session duration in seconds since session start

name: fact_check_passed
description: Whether deterministic post-generation numeric fact-check passed

name: evaluation_grade
description: Gemini 3.5 Flash LLM-as-a-Judge rubric grade (pass, needs_revision, fail)

name: evaluation_score
description: Gemini 3.5 Flash composite evaluation score [0.0, 1.0]
